## chat-orchestration

Implements the `N8N_WEBHOOK_URL` contract `backend/apps/chat-bot-service/src/n8n/n8n.client.ts` calls.

RAG retrieval is no longer done here — llm-service does its own S3 Vectors lookup (`langchain_rag/llm-service/app/retrieval.py`) whenever it's called without a `context` field, which is exactly what this workflow now sends. There used to be a "Mock RAG (placeholder)" node here standing in for that; it's gone now that the real thing exists on the llm-service side.

See `langchain_rag/n8n/README.md` for how to run and test this locally.
